summary: Keep externally managed engines readable in the authorization-filtered engine inventory after workload registration.
userImpact: Connected managed engines can appear in engine selectors and project deployment targets.

instructions: Upgrade the host packages or application images together; existing managed engine records require no repair.

changes: Engine response schemas accept the existing external_managed ownership mode while ordinary engine write requests remain unchanged.

notes: Persistence and tenant ownership are unchanged. Downgrading restores the previous inventory validation failure for managed engines.

security: Existing authorization, tenant filtering, secret redaction and workload ownership controls remain enforced.

customerDocumentation.reason: Restores an existing managed-engine workflow without changing user configuration or administration instructions.

rollback: Revert to the previous qualified host composition; existing records remain intact.
validation: 140 affected schema, HTTP inventory, workload service and workload route tests passed.
21 engine selector and project deployment-target UI tests passed.
Engine-tenancy and OpenAPI contracts passed, including managed ownership response and write-boundary assertions.
Native ARM64 PostgreSQL managed registration/replay/decommission integration passed with the real persisted row projected into the inventory contract.
Shared, backend-host and frontend-host builds, application typechecks, package version discipline, plugin API compatibility and documentation boundary checks passed.
